name: Fairness Benchmark for AI-Generated Face Detection
description: The task is to evaluate the fairness of AI-generated face detectors across demographic groups using the AI-Face dataset, which includes real and AI-generated faces annotated with demographic attributes such as skin tone, gender, and age.

cr:input.name: AI-Face Dataset
cr:input.description: A million-scale dataset containing 400,885 real face images and 1,245,660 AI-generated face images. The dataset includes demographic annotations for skin tone (Monk Skin Tone Scale), gender (binary categories), and age (five groups: Child, Youth, Adult, Middle-age Adult, Senior). Images are sourced from public datasets and generated using Deepfake Videos, GANs, and Diffusion Models.
cr:input.encodingFormat: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset encoding format]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Predicted fairness evaluation metrics for AI-generated face detectors, including performance disparities across demographic groups.

field.name: detector_name
field.description: The name of the AI-generated face detector being evaluated, e.g., 'StyleGAN Detector'.

field.name: demographic_group
field.description: The demographic group being evaluated, e.g., 'Skin Tone 1', 'Female', or 'Adult'.

field.name: fairness_metric
field.description: The fairness evaluation metric value for the detector on the specified demographic group.

field.name: utility_metric
field.description: The utility evaluation metric value for the detector, e.g., accuracy or F1-score.

cr:evaluation.primaryMetric: [FILL IN THE BLANK: primary evaluation metric]
metrics: [FILL IN THE BLANK: list of all evaluation metrics]
cr:evaluation.higherIsBetter: [FILL IN THE BLANK: true or false]
cr:evaluation.notes: The evaluation includes fairness metrics across demographic groups and utility metrics for overall performance. Specific metric formulas are not provided in the paper.
